criteria.name: No files outside deliverable list modified
criteria.evidence: Only src/sims/markus-lyapunov/kernel.ts and model.ts exist as new files. No modifications to other repo files detected in the provided artefacts. The worker respected the scope constraint.

additional_findings: Worker delivered only 2 of 6 required deliverables. The kernel.ts and model.ts implementations appear mathematically correct: model.ts implements the Lyapunov exponent formula λ = (1/n) Σ log|r_k·(1-2x_k)| with proper warmup/sample split, derivative clamping (MIN_DERIVATIVE=1e-30), and NaN for out-of-bounds (a,b). Kernel.ts implements SimKernel with channelCount=2, proper channel split (stability=max(0,-λ), chaos=max(0,λ)), ceiling=2, sequence enum with 6 options, and rotation animation. However, the critical integration pieces (colormap.ts, test file, registry, presets) are entirely missing. The stage is incomplete and cannot pass verification.
